headline.theorem: erdos477_no_quadratic_tiling (a b c : ℤ) (ha : a ≠ 0) : ¬ ∃ A : Set ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, ∃! p : ℤ × ℤ, p.1 ∈ A ∧ (∃ k : ℤ, p.2 = a*k^2 + b*k + c) ∧ n = p.1 + p.2
headline.generalizes: erdos477_no_square_tiling (campaigns/erdos477-campaign-001/kernel), the (a,b,c)=(1,0,0) instance, re-derived as erdos477_no_square_tiling_recovered
headline.strictly_stronger_than_upstream_variant: FormalConjectures erdos_477.variants.degree_two_dvd_condition_b_ne_zero — needs neither a ∣ b nor b ≠ 0 (recorded as erdos477_no_quadratic_tiling_dvd)
headline.engine: f(r+t) - f(r-t) = (4*a*r + 2*b)*t; a ≠ 0 forces one of the slopes 2b (r=0), 4a (r=1, b=0) nonzero, so the difference set contains a nonzero SUBGROUP Nℤ; uniqueness then embeds A in ℤ/N, A is finite, and a finite A plus a one-sided-bounded tile cannot cover ℤ

open.why_open: The upstream FormalConjectures 477 variants quantify over f.eval '' {n | 0 < n}, i.e. STRICTLY POSITIVE indices. The estate's sealed asset and this generalization both quantify over all k ∈ ℤ. These are different tiling problems: 4 = 2^2 - 0^2 is a difference of two squares but NOT of two positive squares. With k,l > 0 the identity f(r+t) - f(r-t) = (4ar+2b)t is only usable for r > |t|, so the difference set contains no nonzero subgroup and no_tiling_of_subgroup_diff does not apply.
open.cost: medium — the mechanism must be replaced by a co-finite-in-a-class argument, not reused

open.why_open: NOT ATTACKED, per mission. Attack02 now states the boundary exactly: no_tiling_of_subgroup_diff needs a nonzero N with Nℤ inside the difference set. For degree d the difference set has counting function O(R^{2/d}) = o(R) once d ≥ 3, while any nonzero subgroup counts 2R/|N| + O(1), linear in R. So no such N exists and this tool returns nothing — the obstruction must be non-pigeonhole.
open.cost: expensive, no mechanism (ranking's verdict stands, now with a stated reason)

open.typed: ∃ f : ℤ[X], 2 ≤ f.degree ∧ ∃ A : Set ℤ, (unique covering)
open.why_open: An affirmative close of the canonical needs only ONE f and one A. Degree 2 is now fully dead over f(ℤ) (this campaign), so any affirmative witness must have degree ≥ 3. The $0 search over small-degree f with periodic/digit-structured A has still not been run.
